result.title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
result.summary: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.

AI.brief_summary: ChronoGraph 提出功能性 4D 场景图，将动作与可供性部件上的语义/几何状态变化关联，并让观测到的与预期的转变共享同一表示；作者构建 ChronoGraphBench 数据引擎与两阶段训练（图作为思维链的监督微调、联合 4D 图强化学习）来支持 VLM 的交互理解与落地规划。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作直接面向 VLM 的 4D 状态表示与预期状态更新，其「图作为思维链」的显式轨迹与 RL 奖励可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态监督、贡献分配和是否真正使用推理状态提供可核查对照；但其推理仍在显式图轨迹上，而非 latent 状态，需进一步确认。
